audio.text: I doubt the rain will stop before the picnic starts.

options: We had a lot of fun at last year's picnic, didn't we?
I stopped at the store on the way to buy drinks.
Then we could hold it in the common room instead.
I doubt she'll be late, since she never is.

why.en: Doubt → an alternative plan ("Then we could..."). B repeats "stop" in a different sense; D repeats "doubt" about something unrelated; A talks about a past picnic instead of responding.
why.tr: Şüphe → alternatif bir plan ("Then we could..."). B "stop" kelimesini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor; D "doubt" kelimesini ilgisiz bir konuda tekrar ediyor; A cevap vermek yerine geçen yılki pikniği anlatıyor.
why.es: Duda → un plan alternativo ("Then we could..."). B repite "stop" con otro sentido; D repite "doubt" sobre algo que no tiene relación; A habla de un pícnic pasado en vez de responder.
